library: VSCO 2 Community Edition (VS Chamber Orchestra: CE)
author: Versilian Studios / Sam Gossner & Simon Dalzell; sample cutting by Elan Hickler (Soundemote)
processing: Leading silence trimmed (2 ms kept), long sustains shortened with an 80 ms fade, short samples given a 15 ms tail fade, stereo and sample rate kept, FLAC output. No instrument waveform is synthesized.
pitch_convention: VSCO usually names middle C as C3 (C3 = 60); the upright piano, harp, solo violin Arco Vib and tubular bells folders name it C4 instead, so their root_midi values are lowered by 12 (verified by autocorrelation pitch measurement). Timpani roots are measured per drum. tuning_cents is the measured offset from the root where the measurement was reliable.
